prompt: What neutralizes acid right next to the stomach wall?

options.text: Bicarbonate trapped in the mucus layer
The blood flowing through the stomach

explanation: Mucus forms a barrier that holds bicarbonate against the cells, creating an almost neutral zone right beside the wall.

prompt: What discovery earned Barry Marshall and Robin Warren the 2005 Nobel Prize?

options.text: That the bacterium Helicobacter pylori causes many ulcers
That the stomach produces hydrochloric acid
That stress is the only cause of ulcers

explanation: They showed H. pylori is behind a large share of ulcers, which made it possible to treat them with antibiotics.
misconception: Stress can worsen symptoms, but the idea that it was the main cause of ulcers was overturned by this discovery.
